Text: Usama was excellent to work with. He assisted my business in spotting branding opportunities and was always thoughtful, professional, and responsive. He thinks outside the box and is a fantastic addition to any public relations or marketing plan.

Sabir and I met each other by happenstance as our daughters are in the same class at Denver Public Schools. I'm an attorney in town, but I work with primarily CPAs, so Sabir has regularly been kind enough to meet me for coffee and help me outline some processes to implement in my own practice. His ability to organize and systematize is an invaluable resource and I look forward to seeing him at drop off each day so I can ask him for advice on a variety of questions. He's just as generous with his time as he is efficient and skillful.

Carolyn is an efficient, hard working, personable person who made an excellent manager for the entire technical needs of three campuses of Northeastern State University.  She truly kept the trains running on time, effectively scheduling, training, and managing dozens of technical consultants on each campus.  Every technical consultant I worked with had nothing but good things to say about Carolyn; she was regarded with complete respect by the people who reported to her.  I am truly grateful for the skills I learned under her.
